name: Half-Drow
desc: Humans with drow blood: sharp-eyed in the dark and touched by the Underdark's innate magic.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.desc: You have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Charmed condition.

traits.name: Drow Darkvision
traits.desc: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Drow Magic
traits.desc: Starting at level 3, you always have Faerie Fire prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in this way when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have.
